summary_1line: Drona foresees ominous signs of Bhishma’s impending fall and instructs his son to confront Arjuna and Sikhandin as the Pandava assault intensifies.

image_candidates.scene_text: Drona stands in his chariot amid the battlefield, pointing out dark omens in the sky as vultures circle and meteors streak past the dimmed sun.
Arjuna with Krishna driving the chariot charges forward with the ape-banner flying, arrows raining as the Kaurava army recoils like waves before a whale.
Drona solemnly instructs his son before battle while the battlefield trembles with jackals howling and warriors in golden armor preparing for carnage.
